main.description: A self-published declaration that this identity maintains an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. One record per server, on the publisher's own PDS; the record key is conventionally a slug of the server name so redeploys update in place. Directories (e.g. mcp.waow.tech) are projections over these records.

description.description: What the server does, one paragraph.

transport.description: How clients connect. 'http' servers are hosted at `url`; 'stdio' servers are run locally from `repo`.

url.description: Remote endpoint for hosted servers (streamable HTTP). Omit for local-only servers.

manifest.description: URL of a machine-readable manifest (e.g. a raw fastmcp.json) describing how to run the server from source.

language.description: Implementation language. Informational — clients never need it to run or connect.

tools.description: Tools the server exposes. Advisory; crawlers may verify by connecting.

environment.description: Environment variables the server reads, so clients know what to configure before running or connecting.

packages.description: Where the server is distributed, one entry per registry. Ecosystems are values, not structure — no language is privileged.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was created.

envVar.description: One environment variable the server reads.

required.description: Whether the server refuses to work without this. Defaults to false (optional).

description.description: What the variable configures and where to get a value.

package.description: One distribution of the server in a package registry.

registry.description: Package ecosystem this entry refers to.

identifier.description: Package name within the registry, e.g. 'tangled-mcp' on pypi.

version.description: Version this record describes. Omit to mean latest.

name.description: Tool name as served over MCP.

description.description: What the tool does, one line.
